plugins.name: scott-skills
plugins.description: Scott's end-to-end workflow for Claude Code: shape an effort once with /wayfinder — its destination, the behaviors that prove it works, your principles and high-level design — then one lead session builds it unattended, every stage a workflow on rails: a plan of pieces in the local sc forge with no GitHub needed, only the risks that could sink it proved first, every ready piece built in its own workflow as a change for the effort branch, gated by CI run on your machine and spec and standards review agents, verified by driving the real app, decisions citing their grounds and reconsidered when later work strains them, and one branch back to you at the end — or grow a feature a slice at a time with /iterate, decisions made just in time against an effort log in the repo and the next effort's idea parked as a ticket by /seed, client feedback turned into an effort by /triage — every review gate on the finding-pipeline contract, every spawned agent on a policy-resolved model tier, every test run scoped to the change by the repo's TESTING.md — plus standalone skills for grilling, design, domain modeling, prototyping, research, TDD, wizards, verification skills that drive each app the way a user does, writing for agents, Herdr and Rex hand-offs and side panes, cold-reading the docs agents have worn, /tend to keep the repo's CONVENTIONS, TESTING, PRINCIPLES, CONTEXT and ADR docs on purpose as each change lands, a /snag → /autopsy loop that traces friction in past sessions back to the skill text that caused it and replays it as an eval, /rsi, which grades recent sessions from every local coding agent and files the failures these skills caused as snags for that loop, /evals to A/B any skill edit against the text before it, /baseline to seed any repo with your default rules — mise for every command, the lint gate, comment and test standards — from global defaults plus one file per language, and /maintain-iterate, which tunes the /iterate loop from its own runs.
